messages:
alex chen: FYI CI is red on master after the RBAC consolidation — SAST job failing at artifact decrypt. Anyone oncall for keystore?

jordan li: can you paste the error output?

alex chen: paste from GHA: ```ERROR: failed to decrypt artifact: AccessDeniedException: Permission 'cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecryption' denied for serviceAccount: infra-ci@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com (403)```

maria g: that looks like the CI SA lost KMS decrypt role after the RBAC migration. Did someone change bindings?

lee park: I made RBAC cleanup yesterday — scoped down a couple of service accounts. I thought infra-ci was left alone. I reverted what I changed but CI still failing.

security-bot: :rotating_light: alert created: KMS-PERMISSION-INCIDENT-3509997777

jordan li: quick checks: 1) look for SetIamPolicy events in Cloud Audit Logs on that key, 2) confirm which SA the runner is impersonating (it can differ from the artifact owner), 3) try an ephemeral grant as workaround.

alex chen: running `gcloud` to get policy, can someone run: ```gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy infra-key --keyring=infra-keyring --location=global --project=redwood-prod``` and paste?

lee park: ran it, output shows the binding present: ```bindings:\n- role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter\n  members:\n  - serviceAccount:infra-ci@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com```

maria g: ok two possibilities: either the job is using a different SA via impersonation or the key was rotated to a new version with stricter policy. Check the job logs for impersonation principal.

alex chen: job log snippet shows impersonation: serviceAccount:infra-poller@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com

jordan li: bingo — infra-poller doesn't have decrypt rights. Search Cloud Audit Logs for `cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecryption` to confirm which principal attempted decrypt and when.

lee park: adding ephemeral binding now: ```gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding infra-key --keyring=infra-keyring --location=global --member=serviceAccount:infra-poller@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter```

alex chen: retriggering CI... SAST job passed on rerun :tada:

maria g: great. For RCA: infra PR #4321 changed default impersonation fallback which caused some runners to use infra-poller. Assigning follow-up to @lee to confirm intended impersonation and fix fallback.

lee park: will open a ticket. Proposed remediation items: 1) document mapping of runners -> SA, 2) add a premerge lint that verifies referenced KMS keys have expected SA bindings, 3) create a log-based alert (SetIamPolicy on our infra keys) to notify security and infra when key IAM changes, 4) update SAST runner error handling to surface explicit KMS error codes.

alex chen: I created INFRA-782 and linked the failing job and PR. Tagging security for postmortem notes.

security-bot: incident created: https://incidents.redwood.ai/3509997777 — assigned to lee park, severity P2

maria g: small action item: add a line to SDLC checklist: "verify KMS key bindings for service accounts used by CI/CD runners" and add a quick runbook how to add ephemeral grants.

alex chen: I'll open a small PR to improve the SAST runner error message to include the KMS error code and principal. Thanks all :thumbsup:

lee park: filing followups now, will include audit log queries and the premerge check design.

jordan li: noted — good find and quick mitigation.
